subject: Evaluation -> Signature orchestration: proposed timeline & gating
messages:
From: Sarah Reid <sarah.reid@heliotherapeutics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Li <david.li@heliotherapeutics.com>, Helio Procurement <procurement@heliotherapeutics.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + target close: MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're keen to scope a short evaluation (pilot) and get legal/procurement moving on a small MSA + DPA + order form for a Q3 pilot. Procurement asked me for a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out who needs to do what and when — they have a budget committee meeting on 7/13 and ideally want signature by 7/15 if possible.

Can you send a suggested MAP that sequences the MSA, DPA, and PO/order form reviews? Key constraints from our side:
- DPA must be reviewed by privacy counsel (turnaround ~5 business days)
- Procurement needs a completed vendor onboarding packet and PO template by the time of the budget meeting

If you can send a week-by-week plan with clear owner handoffs, that will help our internal approvals.

Appreciate it —
Sarah
Sarah Reid
Head of Clinical Ops, Helio Therapeutics
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Reid <sarah.reid@heliotherapeutics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + target close: MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — attached is a proposed MAP tailored to the constraints you listed (see "Proposed_MAP_HelioTherapeutics_v1.pdf" and the week checklist). High level approach we recommend:

1) Run the MSA and order form in parallel where possible, with the DPA routed in parallel to privacy counsel (to avoid serial waits).
2) Redwood legal (Jonas) will triage MSA comments immediately; DPA comments routed to Jonas + privacy specialist (we'll identify our point).
3) Procurement-only items (vendor packet, tax forms, PO template) can be finalized while legal is reviewing contractual redlines — this prevents the budget meeting from being a blocker.

Proposed timeline (week-by-week, target signature 2027-07-15):
- Week 0 (6/29): Deliver MAP + request Helio's preferred redline tool and PO template. (Owner: Hannah/Helio)
- Week 1 (7/1–7/7): Parallel legal review windows: Redwood legal reviews Helio redlines (2 business days), Helio privacy counsel reviews DPA (expected 5 business days). Procurement works vendor packet. (Owner: Jonas / Helio counsel / Helio procurement)
- Week 2 (7/8–7/14): Finalize redlines, legal alignment call if needed (we propose 7/11), procurement confirms PO and budget docs, prepare DocuSign envelope. (Owner: Hannah/Legal/Procurement)
- Week 3 (target 7/15): Formal signature + PO issuance. If DPA outstanding, execute MSA + order form with an interim data handling addendum and finish DPA within 7 days. (Owner: Execs/Procurement)

Risks & mitigations:
- If privacy counsel requests significant DPA changes, we recommend an "MSA-first" fallback with an interim data addendum (keeps pilot live while DPA finishes).
- Ensure SOC2 evidence and sample logs are pre-shared to speed checks (attachment: SOC2-evidence-readme.pdf).

I've attached a concise week-by-week checklist and a one-page MAP for your procurement team to present at the budget meeting. If you can confirm Helio's privacy counsel contact and PO template today/tomorrow we'll slot a legal alignment call for Friday 7/2.

Next steps:
- Sarah: confirm PO template and privacy counsel contact
- Jonas: prep preliminary MSA redline window and flag any high-risk clauses
- Hannah: schedule alignment call 7/2 10:00am PT (tentative)

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Reid <sarah.reid@heliotherapeutics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + target close: MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Sarah / Hannah —

Agree with the parallel approach. A couple of legal items to call out so Helio knows what will speed review:

- DPA: our standard DPA is fairly prescriptive on subprocessors and export controls. If Helio's privacy counsel requires non-standard flow (e.g., bespoke transfer mechanisms), that is the main driver of delay. Estimated review: 3–7 business days depending on scope.
- MSA: key negotiation hotspots we typically see: liability cap, indemnity carve-outs, and IP/residuals. We can prepare a redline that keeps commercial terms intact and narrows the draft to a handful of negotiable clauses.
- Evidence: to avoid repeated back-and-forth on SOC2, send a one-page snapshot of the most recent report + contact for our SOC2 auditor (see SOC2-evidence-readme.pdf attachment).

Operational suggestion: designate a single procurement and a single legal reviewer on each side and copy them on all thread updates. It cuts chase time.

I'll prepare a tight MSA redline tonight and be ready for the alignment call. If Helio confirms they can accept an interim MSA + order form signature with DPA to follow within 7 days, we can meet the 7/15 target.

- Jonas
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Helio Procurement <procurement@heliotherapeutics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Reid <sarah.reid@heliotherapeutics.com>, David Li <david.li@heliotherapeutics.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + target close: MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Hannah / Jonas —

Thanks for the plan. A few constraints from procurement side:
- Our budget committee meets 7/13; the committee requires a completed vendor packet (W-9, vendor profile) and a draft PO/amount to include on the agenda.
- We use our internal PO template (attached: Helio_PO_template.docx) and generally need 48 hours for internal PO approvals once legal signs off.
- We can accept an interim execution approach (MSA + order form) if the DPA review is explicitly scheduled to finish within 7 calendar days after signature.

Action items for us:
- We'll send vendor onboarding packet by EOD 7/2.
- David Li will be Helio's single procurement reviewer for the transaction. He will be on the 7/13 committee call.

Please proceed with the alignment call tomorrow and circulate DocuSign envelope when ready. If we have MSA + order form signed by 7/15, we will issue the PO within 48 hours.

Thanks —
Helio Procurement Team
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helio Procurement <procurement@heliotherapeutics.com>, Sarah Reid <sarah.reid@heliotherapeutics.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + target close: MSA/DPA/order form sequencing

Perfect — thanks David / team.

Per the call, I've attached the final MAP (MAP-week-by-week-checklist.xlsx and a one-page summary). Next steps we agreed on the call:
- Helio: send vendor packet and PO template (David) by EOD 7/2 (received vendor packet).
- Redwood Legal (Jonas): deliver MSA redline by EOD 7/2 and stand by for a quick redlines call on 7/11 if needed.
- Helio privacy counsel: begin DPA review (target finish 7/12).
- Hannah: prep DocuSign envelope and route for signature once MSA/order form aligned (target 7/13–7/15).

I'll push a HubSpot update (link in related_links) and open the DocuSign envelope after Jonas posts the MSA redline. If anything slips, we'll revert to the interim-data-addendum approach so pilot access is not delayed.

Thanks everyone — please reply with any missing owners.

Hannah
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
